newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen 1995/96 group net 350 mln DM.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen 1995/96 group net 350 mln DM.

text.p: largest steel maker, Thyssen AG, said on Friday it expects its results to improve gradually in the current business year.
Group net profit fell to 350 million marks in the year ended September 30 from 775 million the year before.
The company said it expects clear improvement and stabilisation of its profits in the medium term.
Pretax profit in 1995/96 dropped to 654 million marks from 1.026 billion marks the year before, while sales edged down to 38.7 billion marks from 39.1 billion marks.
"In view of a light upward economic development, a gradually improving development of the Thyssen Group is expected," the company said in a statement.

"In the medium term at least we expect a clear improvement and stabilisation of the profit situation due to the continued slimming of the group structure and the building up of core businesses," it said.
The company said it would cut its 1995/96 dividend to eight marks from 10 marks.
Thyssen said it would reorganize into five primary and five secondary profit centres, and divest itself of loss-making and non-core operations.
The core divisions will be Thyssen Aufzuege lift manufacturing, automotive components, flat steel production, production systems, and materials trading.
